issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Snag by Parallel
products.tagline: Find the best deals on products from your agents
products.summaryZh: 寻找来自您的代理商的产品最佳优惠
products.descriptionZh: 找到你一直在向ChatGPT、Claude和其他代理询问的产品的最佳优惠。Snag将这些对话转化为一键导入的愿望清单，将每件商品匹配到确切产品，并跨商店比价。清单按最佳优惠排序，每个价格都与其标价进行对比评估，任何清单都可以通过链接分享。100%免费，赶在黑色星期五之前推出。由Parallel Shopping API和Parallel Images API提供支持。
products.description: Find the best deals on the products you've been asking ChatGPT, Claude, and other agents about. Snag turns those conversations into a wishlist you import in one click, matches each item to the exact product, and checks prices across stores. Lists are sorted by best deal, every price is rated against its list price, and any list can be shared with a link. 100% free, in time for Black Friday. Powered by the Parallel Shopping API and Parallel Images API.

products.name: Omi X 2.0
products.tagline: Omi can build anything. Your $1B idea, live in production
products.summaryZh: Omi 能构建任何东西。你的 10 亿美元创意，直接投入生产环境。
products.descriptionZh: Omi 能构建任何东西。Omi X 2.0 是适用于 Mac 和 Windows 的桌面应用，可在你自己的 Google Cloud 和 Firebase 上构建生产级 AI SaaS。2.0 新增功能：指向并编辑让你点击运行中应用的任意部分，并告诉 Omi 要更改什么。打开现有项目可导入你自己的 Next.js 应用；Omi 会测试、构建并部署它。新项目从经过测试的起始模板开始。免费计划，无需信用卡；构建服务每月 29 美元起。
products.description: Omi can build anything. Omi X 2.0 is the desktop app for Mac and Windows that builds a production AI SaaS on your own Google Cloud and Firebase. New in 2.0: Point and edit lets you click any part of your running app and tell Omi what to change. Open an existing project brings in your own Next.js app; Omi tests, builds and deploys it. New projects start from a tested starter. Plan free, no card; building from $29 a month.

products.name: Statefold
products.tagline: Coding agents that keep working while you're away
products.summaryZh: 编码代理在你离开时仍持续工作
products.descriptionZh: Statefold 在自有云计算机上运行你的编码代理（Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode、Pi 或 Gemini CLI），因此即使你合上笔记本电脑，它也会继续工作。给它一个任务，它就会编写代码、进行测试并创建拉取请求。如果检查失败或审阅者留下评论，代理会看到并在同一对话中修复。你可以从电脑或手机审阅更改并合并。它支持你已付费的订阅或 API 密钥。
products.description: Statefold runs your coding agent (Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Pi or Gemini CLI) on its own cloud computer, so it keeps working after you close your laptop. Give it a task and it writes the code, tests it and opens a pull request. If a check fails or a reviewer leaves a comment, the agent sees it and fixes it in the same conversation. Review the changes and merge from your computer or your phone. It works with the subscription or API key you already pay for.

products.name: Notely
products.tagline: Notion-grade power & BYOK AI, stored locally in SQLite
products.summaryZh: Notion 级强大功能与 BYOK AI，本地存储于 SQLite
products.descriptionZh: 告别每年120美元的笔记订阅。Notely 是一个100%离线优先的 Windows 11 工作区，由 SQLite WAL + FTS5 搜索提供支持——无需账户、无遥测、永久免费。最多可打开24个 Chrome 风格标签页，撰写富文本笔记，支持可调整大小的表格、便签、内置计算器和实时内联秒表计时器，比较词级版本历史，使用 Argon2id + AES-256-GCM 锁定敏感笔记，通过 Print Studio 导出无损 notely/PDF，并可选择启用 BYOK Gemini 或 GroqCloud AI。
products.description: Ditch $120/yr note subscriptions. Notely is a 100% offline-first Windows 11 workspace backed by SQLite WAL + FTS5 search—no accounts, no telemetry, free forever. Open up to 24 Chrome-style tabs, write rich notes with resizable tables, sticky notes, built-in calculator & live inline stopwatch timers, compare word-level version history, lock sensitive notes with Argon2id + AES-256-GCM, export losslessnotely/PDF via Print Studio, and opt in to BYOK Gemini or GroqCloud AI.

products.name: PeerBand
products.tagline: Reach every coding agent you run, from anywhere
products.summaryZh: 随时随地触达你运行的每一个编码代理
products.descriptionZh: 将你在 Herdr 中运行的编码代理连接起来，覆盖你的笔记本电脑、台式机和虚拟机。通过 ChatGPT 或其他 MCP 客户端查看它们正在处理什么。当某个代理需要你时，收到 Telegram 消息，然后从手机上回复那个确切的代理。在每台机器上安装 PeerBand，无需 SSH 即可联系你的代理。
products.description: Connect the coding agents you run in Herdr across your laptop, desktop, and VMs. Check what they’re working on from ChatGPT or another MCP client. Get a Telegram message when an agent needs you, then reply to that exact agent from your phone. Install PeerBand on each machine and reach your agents without SSH.

products.name: Oculon
products.tagline: The agentic finance platform for the CFO's office
products.summaryZh: 面向CFO办公室的智能体金融平台
products.descriptionZh: Oculon 是代理驱动的财务平台，由可运行完整工作流的代理提供支持，兼具精确性与控制力。从预测和差异分析到报告和数据运营，连接 QuickBooks、Xero、Zoho Books、HubSpot、Salesforce 等工具，代理可在 10 分钟内构建你的首个模型。每个代理都基于你业务的实时上下文工作，每个数字都可追溯至其来源，每项操作都会提交给你审批。符合 SOC 2 Type II、ISO 27001、GDPR。
products.description: Oculon is the agentic finance platform powered by agents that run complete workflows, with precision and control. From forecasts and variance analysis to reporting and data ops, connect tools like QuickBooks, Xero, Zoho Books, HubSpot, Salesforce, and agents build your first model in 10 minutes. Every agent works from a living context of your business, every number drills back to its source, and every action is brought back to you for approval. Compliant with SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, GDPR.

products.name: ETAOS
products.tagline: Your entire company. One operating system.
products.summaryZh: 整个公司，一个操作系统。
products.descriptionZh: 公司不缺软件，缺的是拼凑式方案：6到15个互不相连的工具，数据各自孤立，工作流靠手工拼接。ETAOS用一个AI原生操作系统取代这种拼凑，围绕你组织的实际运作方式来配置——CRM、项目、财务、人力资源、分析、学习，以及针对你运行的其他任何业务的定制模块。一个系统，一份记忆。你第一次可以与自己企业对话。
products.description: Companies don't have a software problem. They have a patchwork problem: 6 to 15 disconnected tools, data in silos, workflows stitched together by hand. ETAOS replaces the patchwork with one AI-native operating system configured around how your organization actually works - CRM, projects, finance, HR, analytics, learning, plus custom modules for anything else you run. One system, one memory. For the first time, you can talk to your business.

products.name: Data Career School
products.tagline: Data, ML & AI Interview Prep | Projects | AI Mock Interviews
products.summaryZh: 数据、机器学习与人工智能面试准备 | 项目 | AI模拟面试
products.descriptionZh: Data Career School 是面向数据、机器学习和人工智能专业人士的面试准备平台。 - 通过 300 多道公司专属问题准备 SQL、DSA、AI 工程、行为面试、商业案例研究等。 - 使用杂乱的真实数据集，构建数据科学、机器学习和人工智能领域的实践项目。 - 参加 AI 驱动的模拟面试，获取即时反馈。
products.description: Data Career School is an interview preparation platform for Data, ML and AI professionals. - Prepare with 300+ company-specific questions across SQL, DSA, AI Engineering, behavioral interviews, business case studies, and more. - Build hands-on projects across Data Science, Machine Learning, and AI using messy, real-world datasets. - Take AI-powered mock interviews to get instant feedback.

products.name: gratis
products.tagline: Use open source AI models locally for free in a few clicks.
products.summaryZh: 只需点击几下，即可在本地免费使用开源AI模型。
products.descriptionZh: gratis 让你在自己的机器上私密运行开源 AI 模型，只需几次点击，即可在浏览器标签页或可下载的应用中完成。免费，且无使用限制。你可以从模型目录中挑选模型，或加载 Hugging Face 上的任意 GGUF 模型。gratis 会将其下载到你的设备并在本地运行。浏览器将 WebAssembly 内存限制在 4GB，低于实用模型所需。我们将推理运行时分支到 64 位寻址，以达到 16GB，这正是真正规模的模型能装进一个标签页的原因。
products.description: gratis runs open source AI models privately on your own machine, inside a browser tab or downloadable app, in just a few clicks. Free, with no usage limits. Pick a model from the catalogue or load any GGUF model from Hugging Face. gratis downloads it to your device and runs the model there. Browsers cap WebAssembly memory at 4GB, below what a useful model needs. We forked the inference runtime onto 64-bit addressing to reach 16GB, which is why a model of real size fits in a tab.

products.name: FolioGen
products.tagline: Turn your CV or business into a portfolio website
products.summaryZh: 把你的简历或业务变成一个作品集网站
products.descriptionZh: 你的简历列出了你曾在哪些地方工作。FolioGen 将其转化为一个展示工作成果的网站。上传简历（如果没有，回答五个问题即可），AI 会撰写并搭建你的作品集：标题、简介、带有独立案例研究页面的项目，以及联系表单。从七种模板中选择，设置颜色和字体，并发布在你自己的链接上。通过无 Cookie 洞察查看谁访问过，并针对特定招聘广告定制你的介绍。免费开始，预览无需账户。
products.description: Your CV lists where you worked. FolioGen turns it into a website that shows the work. Upload a CV (or answer five questions if you have none) and AI writes and builds your portfolio: headline, summary, projects with their own case study pages, and a contact form. Pick from seven templates, set your colours and fonts, and publish on your own link. See who visited with cookie-free insights, and tailor your intro to a specific job ad. Free to start, no account needed to preview.

products.name: Timewize
products.tagline: Run resources, projects & finances in one platform
products.summaryZh: 在一个平台上管理资源、项目和财务
products.descriptionZh: Timewize 是一个面向代理机构、IT 服务、会计和咨询公司的 PSA 平台。在一个地方规划资源、运行项目、跟踪时间、向客户计费并查看项目利润。内置 AI：一个能回答你数据问题的助手、一个预填工时表的工时草稿助手、一个帮助建立项目的项目代理，以及一个能提前标记预算超支和利润风险的消耗与预测代理。
products.description: Timewize is a PSA platform for agencies, IT services, accounting and consulting firms. Plan resources, run projects, track time, bill clients and see project margin in one place. Built-in AI: an assistant that answers questions on your data, a time-draft assistant that pre-fills timesheets, a project agent that helps set up projects, and burn and predictive agents that flag budget overrun and margin risk early.

products.name: KoiArt
products.tagline: Christmas is here. On your Mac and PC
products.summaryZh: 圣诞节到了。在您的Mac和PC上
products.descriptionZh: 每扇窗户上落着雪，桌面上立着雪人，圣诞老人驾雪橇驶过，一列小火车为你的朋友送去礼物，还有个雪怪惦记着你的雪人。一次购买，永久使用。
products.description: Snow on every window, snowmen on your desktop, Santa riding by, a little train that delivers gifts to your friends, and a Yeti who wants your snowman. Buy once, use forever.

products.name: Biomarker Tracker
products.tagline: Track years of blood tests and see your biological age
products.summaryZh: 追踪多年血液检测记录，了解你的生物学年龄
products.descriptionZh: Biomarker Tracker 是一款免费的开源应用，可将多年的化验结果和身体测量数据整合在一张图表中。它能计算你的生物学年龄（PhenoAge）、心脏年龄和体能年龄，用通俗的语言解释每一项指标并附上来源，还能区分真正的变化与正常波动。它可读取化验单 PDF，并导入 Apple Health、Garmin、Oura 等数据。所有数据都保存在你的电脑上：无需账户、不上云、不追踪。支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux，也可在浏览器中试用。
products.description: Biomarker Tracker is a free, open-source app that keeps years of lab results and body measurements in one chart. It works out your biological age (PhenoAge), heart age and fitness age, explains every marker in plain words with sources, and tells a real change from normal variation. It reads lab PDFs and imports Apple Health, Garmin, Oura and more. Everything stays on your computer: no account, no cloud, no tracking. Windows, macOS and Linux, or try it in your browser.

products.name: Niro
products.tagline: Hermes, DeepSeek Harness, Qwen, Kimi & more on your iPhone
products.summaryZh: Hermes、DeepSeek Harness、Qwen、Kimi 等，尽在你的 iPhone 上
products.descriptionZh: 跨项目及 AI 智能体对话搜索。在 iPhone 上继续你的 Mac 编程工作。NIRO 将 Hermes、DeepSeek Harness、OpenCode、Qwen Code、Kimi Code 和 MiMo 整合到一个本地优先的工作空间中。使用通用搜索查找已索引的对话，通过项目记忆回顾项目上下文，并借助 Niro Bridge 接续受支持的会话。功能因智能体而异。
products.description: Search across projects and AI agent conversations. Continue your Mac-based coding work from your iPhone. NIRO connects Hermes, DeepSeek Harness, OpenCode, Qwen Code, Kimi Code and MiMo in one local-first workspace. Use Universal Search to find indexed conversations, revisit project context with Project Memory, and pick up supported sessions through Niro Bridge. Features vary by agent.

products.name: LiveGrid
products.tagline: Screen share with friends: every screen at once, with sound
products.summaryZh: 与朋友共享屏幕：所有屏幕同时呈现，带声音
products.descriptionZh: LiveGrid 是一款群组通话应用，每个人都能同时并排共享屏幕，每个屏幕都有独立的音量滑块和声音。创建房间、发送链接，好友即可通过浏览器加入，手机上也行。无需安装。语音、聊天和观看屏幕免费。Pro 版每月 4.99 美元，含 7 天免费试用：以源质量无限共享，最高 60 fps。另有适用于 Windows 和 Mac 的桌面应用。
products.description: LiveGrid is a group call app where everyone can share their screen at the same time, side by side, each screen with its own volume slider and its own sound. Open a room, send the link, and friends join from the browser, even on a phone. Nothing to install. Voice, chat and watching screens are free. Pro is US$ 4.99/mo with a 7-day free trial: unlimited sharing at source quality, up to 60 fps. Desktop app for Windows and Mac too.

products.name: GPTA - Get paid to train AI
products.tagline: All AI training jobs in one place
products.summaryZh: 所有AI训练工作集中于此
products.descriptionZh: 将我们免费的 MCP 服务器连接到 Claude、ChatGPT 或任何 agent，然后说“帮我找时薪 150 美元以上的远程 AI 训练工作”。它会从包含 Mercor、Alignerr 和 OpenTrain 在内的 20 多家公司的开放数据标注和 AI 训练职位中，搜索一个实时更新的职位目录。
products.description: Connect our free MCP server to Claude, ChatGPT or any agent and say "Find me remote AI training jobs paying $150+/hr." It searches an up-to-date directory of open data labeling and AI training jobs from 20+ companies, including Mercor, Alignerr and OpenTrain.

products.name: Tutorials Kit
products.tagline: Your agent keeps your tutorial videos in sync with your app
products.summaryZh: 你的代理让教程视频与应用保持同步
products.descriptionZh: 开源 CLI，供你的编码代理将应用工作流转化为带旁白的教程视频和书面指南。在 Claude Code、Cursor 或 Codex 中输入一条提示即可完成设置：它会编写 Playwright 流程、录制你的应用、使用 ElevenLabs 配音，并通过 Remotion 渲染。每次发布变更时，你的代理会运行检查，找出已失效的教程，并仅重新构建这些教程。MIT 许可，本地运行，自带密钥。
products.description: Open-source CLI your coding agent uses to turn your app's workflows into narrated tutorial videos and written guides. One prompt in Claude Code, Cursor or Codex sets it up: it writes Playwright flows, records your app, narrates with ElevenLabs and renders with Remotion. Each time you ship a change, your agent runs check to find the tutorials that broke and rebuilds just those. MIT, runs locally, bring your own keys.

products.name: Kelimoji
products.tagline: A Turkish-language word party game for one phone
products.summaryZh: 一款适合单部手机玩的土耳其语词语派对游戏
products.descriptionZh: Kelimoji 是一款节奏明快的土耳其语猜词派对游戏，适合朋友和家人用一部手机游玩。一名玩家描述卡片上的词，但不能说出卡片上的五个禁忌词，同时队伍要争分夺秒。游戏包含 5,000 多张精心挑选的土耳其语卡片，涵盖 5 个难度等级和 122 个类别，支持 2 至 6 支队伍，完全离线运行。免费，无需注册，游戏中途无广告。所有卡片和界面均为土耳其语。
products.description: Kelimoji is a fast word-guessing party game in Turkish for friends and family, played on one phone. One player describes the word on the card without saying any of its five forbidden words while the team races the clock. 5,000+ hand-picked Turkish cards across 5 difficulty levels and 122 categories, 2 to 6 teams, and it works fully offline. Free, with no sign-up and no ads mid-round. All cards and the interface are in Turkish.

products.name: LiveGrid Classic
products.tagline: Watch Twitch, YouTube and Kick lives in one grid
products.summaryZh: 在一个网格中观看Twitch、YouTube和Kick直播
products.descriptionZh: LiveGrid Classic 可将多个直播流放在同一屏幕上：Twitch、YouTube、Kick 和直播电视链接并排显示，支持 1 至 8 个画面。选择一个分类（GTA VI、CS、LoL、VALORANT、Dota 2……），网格便会填入当前正在直播的内容，也可粘贴任意频道链接。可切换、静音、拖动排序、打开 Twitch 聊天、进入影院模式、分享你的网格。浏览器中免费使用，最多 4 路直播流，无需信用卡。可选 Pro 方案解锁 8 路。
products.description: LiveGrid Classic puts several live streams on one screen: Twitch, YouTube, Kick and live TV links side by side, from 1 to 8 screens. Pick a category (GTA VI, CS, LoL, VALORANT, Dota 2...) and the grid fills with who is live right now, or paste any channel link. Swap, mute, reorder by dragging, open the Twitch chat, go cinema mode, share your grid. Free in the browser, up to 4 streams, no card. An optional Pro plan unlocks 8.

products.name: CocoReader: Book to Audiobook
products.tagline: Listen to the books you already own
products.summaryZh: 聆听您已拥有的书籍
products.descriptionZh: 聆听你已经拥有的书籍。CocoReader 可将你的书籍和文档转换为有声书，在 iPhone、iPad、Apple Silicon Mac、Apple Watch 和 CarPlay 上提供 20 多种自然语音。导入 EPUB、PDF、纯文本、照片或网页文章，选择语音，然后按下播放。这个黑色星期五，首年价格为 19.99 美元，优惠截至 2026 年 12 月 1 日。
products.description: Listen to the books you already own. CocoReader turns your books and documents into audiobooks with 20+ natural voices on iPhone, iPad, Apple Silicon Mac, Apple Watch, and CarPlay. Import EPUB, PDF, plain text, photos, or a web article, pick a voice, and press play. This Black Friday, the first year is US$19.99 through December 1, 2026.
